content_en.prompt: When an aircraft lands at an airport, it is assigned a corridor — a designated airspace that separates it from other planes, to avoid accidents. At Bebrasland airport, two aircraft landing within 15 minutes of each other cannot share the same corridor. For example, if Flight #1 lands at 6:10, Flight #2 at 6:25, and Flight #3 at 6:26, then Flight #1 and #2 cannot share a corridor (exactly 15 minutes apart still counts as "within"), but Flight #3 can share a corridor with Flight #1 (16 minutes apart) though not with Flight #2 (1 minute apart). As Air Traffic Controller, assign corridors for today's flights: 9W2400 7:00, 9W1321 7:21, AI561 7:20, AI620 7:18, EK427 7:03, SG147 7:12.
content_en.question: What is the minimum number of corridors needed to ensure all flights land according to the rules?
content_en.explanation: Sorted by time: 9W2400(7:00), EK427(7:03), SG147(7:12), AI620(7:18), AI561(7:20), 9W1321(7:21). Assigning greedily: Corridor1={9W2400,AI620}, Corridor2={EK427,AI561}, Corridor3={SG147}, Corridor4={9W1321} — 9W1321 conflicts with SG147/AI620/AI561 (all within 15min), forcing a 4th corridor.
content_en.ct_explanation: This is a graph coloring problem: flights are nodes, conflicts (landing within 15 min) are edges, and corridors are colors — find the minimum colors so no connected nodes share one. Graph coloring applies to scheduling, radio bandwidth allocation, exam timetabling, and even Sudoku. A greedy algorithm (sorting by landing time, assigning the first available non-conflicting corridor) solves this efficiently, though greedy methods don't always give optimal results in general.

content_zh.prompt: 飛機降落機場時會被分配一條「航道」——這是一塊指定的空域，用來讓飛機彼此保持間隔、避免發生意外。在Bebrasland機場，如果兩架飛機降落時間相差在15分鐘以內，就不能用同一條航道。舉例來說，如果1號班機6:10降落、2號班機6:25降落、3號班機6:26降落，那麼1號和2號不能用同一條航道（因為剛好相差15分鐘也算「在15分鐘以內」），但3號可以跟1號共用航道（相差16分鐘），卻不能跟2號共用（只相差1分鐘）。身為今天的航管員，請為以下班機時刻分配航道：9W2400於7:00、9W1321於7:21、AI561於7:20、AI620於7:18、EK427於7:03、SG147於7:12。
content_zh.question: 要讓所有班機都符合規則降落，最少需要幾條航道？
content_zh.ct_skills: 演算法思維（Algorithmic Thinking）、抽象化（Abstraction）
content_zh.ct_explanation: 這是一個「圖著色問題」：班機是節點，時間衝突(15分鐘內)是邊，航道就是顏色——目標是用最少的顏色，讓相連的節點不會用到同一個顏色。圖著色的應用很廣，像是排班、電台頻寬分配、考試排程，甚至數獨。這一題用「貪婪演算法」（按降落時間排序，依序分配第一條不衝突的航道）就能有效解決，不過要注意貪婪演算法不見得每次都能得到最佳解。
